title: Small cones lift through cocartesian fibrations with filtered fibers
statement: Use universes, infinite regular cardinals, small simplicial sets and filtered quasicategories of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category], simplicial maps and horns of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the right cone $K^{\triangleright}=K\star\Delta^0$ of [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone]. Use the horn and cocartesian-edge lifting definitions of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], extended over arbitrary simplicial bases as explicitly defined in [lem-coef-marked-relative-cartesian-model], without requiring the total space or base to be quasicategories. Let $\rho$ be an infinite regular cardinal and $p:E\to S$ a cocartesian fibration in a fixed containing universe. Suppose every vertex fiber $E_s$ is $\rho$-filtered. For every $\rho$-small simplicial set $K$ and simplicial maps $a:K\to E$ and $b:K^{\triangleright}\to S$ satisfying $pa=b|_K$, there is a simplicial map $\bar a:K^{\triangleright}\to E$ with $\bar a|_K=a$ and $p\bar a=b$ exactly. This includes $K=\varnothing$ and imposes no cardinal bound on $E$ or its fibers in the containing universe.
